% titlesec's rules in report's headings, without hyperref: a part's and a
% chapter's display format starting with \titlerule, a section's block
% format ending with \titlerule, \titleformat* with \titlerule, and a
% subsubsection's display label in \titleline, which the page sets
% inside its heading. Each heading keeps the font and alignment of its
% format, and the subsubsection's heading holds no paragraph.
\documentclass{report}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{3}
\titleformat{\part}[display]{\titlerule\filcenter\Huge\scshape}
    {\partname\ \thepart}{20pt}{}
\titleformat{\chapter}[display]
    {\titlerule[1pt]\vspace{1ex}\sffamily\huge\bfseries\filcenter}
    {\chaptertitlename\ \thechapter}{20pt}{}
\titleformat{\section}[block]{\Large\bfseries\titlerule}{\thesection}{1em}{}
\titleformat*{\subsection}{\titlerule\itshape\large}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}[display]{\large}
    {\titleline[c]{\thesubsubsection}}{1ex}{}
\begin{document}
\part{Beginnings}
\chapter{Alpha}
Text after the chapter.
\section{Beta}
Text after the section.
\subsection{Gamma}
Text after the subsection.
\subsubsection{Delta}
Text after the subsubsection.
\end{document}
